These come from my own knowledge, and I didn't open the links to check them, so spot-check a few before relying on them. Some sources are engineering blog posts. Others are the companies' own GitHub repos, which show use but are weaker evidence than a statement.

```json
[
  {"company": "Cloudflare", "use": "Pingora, the HTTP proxy that handles much of Cloudflare's traffic", "source": "https://blog.cloudflare.com/how-we-built-pingora-the-proxy-that-connects-cloudflare-to-the-internet/"},
  {"company": "Discord", "use": "Read States service, rewritten from Go to Rust for latency", "source": "https://discord.com/blog/why-discord-is-switching-from-go-to-rust"},
  {"company": "Dropbox", "use": "File sync engine ('Nucleus')", "source": "https://dropbox.tech/infrastructure/rewriting-the-heart-of-our-sync-engine"},
  {"company": "Amazon Web Services", "use": "Firecracker microVMs, S3 components, Bottlerocket OS", "source": "https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/why-aws-loves-rust-and-how-wed-like-to-help/"},
  {"company": "Microsoft", "use": "Safe systems programming, replacing C/C++ for security-critical code", "source": "https://msrc.microsoft.com/blog/2019/07/why-rust-for-safe-systems-programming/"},
  {"company": "Google", "use": "Android platform components", "source": "https://security.googleblog.com/2021/04/rust-in-android-platform.html"},
  {"company": "Meta", "use": "Server-side services and source control backend; Rust is an officially supported server-side language", "source": "https://engineering.fb.com/2022/07/27/developer-tools/programming-languages-endorsed-for-server-side-use-at-meta/"},
  {"company": "Mozilla", "use": "Firefox's Stylo CSS engine and other browser components", "source": "https://hacks.mozilla.org/2017/08/inside-a-super-fast-css-engine-quantum-css-aka-stylo/"},
  {"company": "Figma", "use": "Multiplayer sync server", "source": "https://www.figma.com/blog/rust-in-production-at-figma/"},
  {"company": "npm, Inc.", "use": "Authorization service in the registry's production stack", "source": "https://www.rust-lang.org/static/pdfs/Rust-npm-Whitepaper.pdf"},
  {"company": "Fastly", "use": "Lucet WebAssembly compiler/runtime for edge compute", "source": "https://www.fastly.com/blog/announcing-lucet-fastly-native-webassembly-compiler-runtime"},
  {"company": "Buoyant (Linkerd)", "use": "linkerd2-proxy service mesh data plane", "source": "https://linkerd.io/2020/07/23/under-the-hood-of-linkerds-state-of-the-art-rust-proxy-linkerd2-proxy/"},
  {"company": "Sentry", "use": "Symbolicator and native crash processing", "source": "https://github.com/getsentry/symbolicator"},
  {"company": "Vercel", "use": "Turbopack bundler", "source": "https://vercel.com/blog/turbopack"},
  {"company": "Deno Land", "use": "Deno JavaScript/TypeScript runtime", "source": "https://deno.com/blog/v1"},
  {"company": "Mullvad VPN", "use": "VPN app daemon and tunnel management", "source": "https://github.com/mullvad/mullvadvpn-app"},
  {"company": "Materialize", "use": "Streaming SQL database", "source": "https://github.com/MaterializeInc/materialize"},
  {"company": "InfluxData", "use": "InfluxDB IOx time-series storage engine", "source": "https://www.influxdata.com/blog/announcing-influxdb-iox/"},
  {"company": "Parity Technologies", "use": "Polkadot/Substrate blockchain node software", "source": "https://github.com/paritytech/polkadot-sdk"},
  {"company": "Solana Labs", "use": "Solana blockchain validator", "source": "https://github.com/solana-labs/solana"},
  {"company": "Oxide Computer", "use": "Rack-scale server control plane and firmware", "source": "https://github.com/oxidecomputer/omicron"},
  {"company": "Datadog", "use": "Vector observability data pipeline", "source": "https://github.com/vectordotdev/vector"},
  {"company": "Embark Studios", "use": "Game development tooling and game services", "source": "https://github.com/EmbarkStudios"},
  {"company": "PingCAP", "use": "TiKV distributed key-value store behind TiDB", "source": "https://github.com/tikv/tikv"},
  {"company": "Brave Software", "use": "Ad-blocking engine in the browser", "source": "https://github.com/brave/adblock-rust"},
  {"company": "Signal Messenger", "use": "libsignal cryptographic protocol library", "source": "https://github.com/signalapp/libsignal"},
  {"company": "Zed Industries", "use": "Zed code editor", "source": "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed"},
  {"company": "Hugging Face", "use": "Tokenizers library and Candle ML framework", "source": "https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers"},
  {"company": "Astral", "use": "Ruff linter and uv Python package manager", "source": "https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff"},
  {"company": "Svix", "use": "Webhook sending service", "source": "https://github.com/svix/svix-webhooks"}
]
```

I can fetch each link and replace any that don't resolve or don't clearly support the claim.
